name: @dusk/worker
comment:exports: `./loop` and `./payout` are subpaths because `.` is main.ts, which reads .env, is Node-only and starts a worker on import. /earn composes the same loop in a browser tab, so it needs the two modules that have no Node in them and must not touch the third. Task A1 verified loop.ts imports nothing Node-only; this map is what stops that from silently regressing.
